name: Zain Ul Abidin
title: Full-Stack Software Engineer
heroLine: I build web applications with React, Node.js, Next.js, TypeScript, and MongoDB. I'm also learning DevOps, with a focus on Docker, CI/CD, and Kubernetes.
bio: Hi 👋, I'm Zain Ul Abidin, a Computer Science student and full-stack developer. I build web applications using React, Node.js, Next.js, TypeScript, and MongoDB, and I enjoy working across both the frontend and backend.

I started with frontend development and gradually moved into APIs, authentication, databases, and real-time features. One of my main projects is Sahiwal Electronics, a multi-vendor e-commerce platform where I worked on user roles, product management, orders, real-time chat, and deployment.

I'm currently in my final year of Computer Science and working on my Final Year Project, SlabGuard. It combines the MERN stack with Python, FastAPI, and the Prophet model to predict electricity bills and warn users before they cross MEPCO's tariff slab thresholds.
Alongside development, I'm learning more about DevOps and how applications are deployed and maintained. Right now, I'm working with Docker, GitHub Actions, CI/CD, and Kubernetes.
Most of my learning comes from building projects and solving problems along the way. I'm always looking to improve, work on useful software, and learn from people with more experience.
